summary: Round 1 spec review of www_tutor_calculator_20261117 at HEAD fb6bf7c0d86033dfb6b055796b4988a424997064. The spec is faithful to PM order A-63 and to Daniel's calculator shape, the money math is correct to the satang under the spec's own D-3 algorithm (which the payout graphic states as the code truth), all named repo paths, components, and gate commands exist, and the en/th copy matches PR copy v0.1 word for word except the marked drafts. Three findings need a spec or plan change before the touched phase: the plan leaves the manifest test's file location open (Blocker), the spec builds an alt text that mislabels a student-app screen as the tutor app without a draft mark (Major), and three '(design rule n)' citations resolve to no readable file (Major).

paraphrase.proposes: The track adds two sections to the www Tutor Advantage page in en, th, and zh. Phase 1 builds a pure satang-exact commission module, a client calculator with three example presets, a one-level leg payout graph, and a decorative rate curve. Phase 2 adds a gallery of three blurred screenshots from the delivered set and replaces the two 'We do not publish income figures' live lines with copy that points at the calculator examples. The zh block takes the English lines until the contracted Chinese speaker delivers. No push happens before the PM page-check, and no deploy command runs. The spec states this intent itself in sections 1, 2, and D-13.
paraphrase.current_system: The page is a server component that reads copy with getScopedI18n from a locale file with en, th, and zh blocks. Its sections are hero, process, tutorRole, commitments, and faq; tutorRole.points[3] and faq.items[5].answer still say no income figures are published. A productPictures manifest and the ProductPicture and SectionHeader components already exist for other pages. The commission truth lives in the finance-mlm-service formula; this track re-implements it as a display-only pure module in the www app, with the rate curve and the 3% withholding tax.

blocking_findings: F1 [Blocker] plan.md task 2.1: the test that asserts the three manifest keys, their widths and heights, and the file existence has no named file. Task 2.1 lists the blur script, the three webp files, and product-pictures.ts, then its Done line says 'one test asserts the three manifest keys' without a path; no existing manifest test exists to extend (the only test that imports productPictures is src/__tests__/products-page-pictures.red.test.tsx, which belongs to the products overview page, track A-62). Rationale: the plan leaves a file-location choice to the implementer, which the review standard rates Blocker. Smallest fix: name the test file in task 2.1, for example the Phase 2 locale test src/__tests__/www-tutor-calculator.locale.test.ts or a named new file.
nonblocking_findings: F2 [Major] spec.md 6.3 items[1] and the Thai table: the lessonPhases alt 'Tutor app showing the 18 phases of one lesson' (en, spec line 553) and the Thai alt 'แอปติวเตอร์แสดง 18 ช่วงของบทเรียนหนึ่งบท' (line 569) name the tutor app, but the mapped source student-mobile/002-screen.png is a student-app screen (student bottom tab bar, student points header), and spec 6.1 classifies student-mobile/ as the student app. The spec marks only presets[2] and chart as drafts, so the wrong alt is built unmarked, and the spec's own note (lines 574-575) verifies only the '18 phases' part. Rationale: published alt text will mislabel the picture it describes; the spec needs a change before Phase 2 Red. Smallest fix: mark the slot-2 alt as a draft for PR like D-2a, or correct it to a student-app wording and record the deviation from copy v0.1.

F3 [Major] spec.md D-9 line 234, D-11 line 253, 6.3 line 544: the citations '(design rule 3)', '(design rule 7)', and '(design rule 8)' point at a numbered design-rules list that exists in no readable file (searched measure/, docs/, measure/archive/). The substance of each rule is stated inline in 5.3, D-9, D-11, and 6.3, so the numbers dangle. Rationale: an undefined project-specific term. Smallest fix: drop the numbered citations, or name the document that holds the list.

F4 [Nit] spec.md AC-3 / plan.md task 1.1 item 4: the conservation check read as exact equality on baht Numbers fails for preset 2 in JS float (8010 + 4645.69 !== 12655.69); the assertion must compare satang integers or use toBeCloseTo. Smallest fix: one clause in plan task 1.1 ('compare in satang integers').

F5 [Nit] spec.md D-2 line 143: 'Every money figure in the brief matches this table' is false at satang level for preset 2: the brief's table (handoff www-tutor-advantage-calculator-handoff.md line 145) gives gross 12,655.70 and net 4,506.33, while D-2 gives 12,655.69 and 4,506.32. The claim holds only at whole-baht rounding (lines 136-137). Smallest fix: qualify the sentence with 'to the whole baht'.
F6 [Nit] spec.md 6.3 line 575: the note quotes student-mobile/002 as showing 'ขั้นที่ 2/18'; the delivered screen shows 'ขั้นที่ 8/18'. Smallest fix: correct the quoted phase number.
evidence: Paraphrase: the spec states its own intent in sections 1, 2, D-4, D-13; no comprehension gap found.

Order fit: the spec does the ordered work only — new screenshots (6.1-6.3 from the delivered set), a commission calculator with networking examples (three presets with legs, D-2), and Daniel's shape (personal students, legs with students by leg, a payout graph, D-4/D-9). The two live-line changes come from PR copy v0.1 section 5, not from this spec. No speculative feature: the rate curve is allowed by the PM handoff spec section 5, the URL parameter and second level are out of scope (section 7).

Money math (node): six check values reproduce to four decimals — 1,000 → 40.5000%, 5,000 → 42.5000%, 10,000 → 45.0000%, 20,000 → 50.0000%, 30,000 → 55.606455% → 55.6065%, 50,000 → 60.631497% → 60.6315%. Asymptote 0.5/0.7 = 71.4286%. Rate at 1e9 = 71.422028% < 71.43% (AC-1 holds). Preset 1: GV 12,000, rate 46%, gross 5,520.00, tax 165.60, net 5,354.40. Preset 2 under D-3 (rateUnits = round(rate*1e9), gvSatang = 2,400,000, BigInt truncation): flatSatang = 1,265,569 → gross 12,655.69; leg payouts 4,005.00 each (8,010.00); payout 4,645.69; tax floor(464,569*3/100) = 139.37; net 4,506.32. Same result with rateUnits truncated instead of rounded. Preset 3: rate 56.695275% → 56.6953%; flatSatang 1,870,944 → gross 18,709.44; leg payouts 4,005.00 each (12,015.00); payout 669,444 satang → 6,694.44; tax 20,083 satang → 200.83; net 649,361 satang → 6,493.61. Conservation holds in satang integers for presets 2 and 3 (1,265,569 = 801,000 + 464,569; 1,870,944 = 1,201,500 + 669,444).

Orchestrator claim resolved: 12,655.70 / 4,645.70 / 4,506.33 comes from rounding the raw float product (rate*24000 = 12,655.699605442065) to satang. The spec's D-3 pins truncation, and the payout graphic (payout-network-en.png, 'Money in satang' box) states truncation with rate scale 10^9 as the code truth. D-2's 12,655.69 / 4,645.69 / 4,506.32 is right; the orchestrator's figures are not.

D-1 quotes verified against the graphic and recomputed: rate(60000) = 62.008093% → 62.0081%, rate*GV = 37,204.85; B1 rate(27000) = 54.3089% × 27,000 = 14,663.41; B2 rate(21000) = 50.7680% × 21,000 = 10,661.28; payout 11,880.16; the graphic states the seven-tutor check and the satang/truncation rule that D-3 carries.

Copy truth: 16 English strings and 7 Thai strings of spec 5.4, 6.3, and 6.4 match the PR copy file word for word (scripted includes-check); the only intended deviation is the D-2a preset-3 draft, which correctly replaces the superseded two-level preset 3. No forbidden D-16 claim (annual, salary, hourly, VAT, Tawi, no earning cap) appears in the new strings; 'example' wording is present in calculator.description and disclaimer; the only percentages are the rate values and the 3% tax that the code-truth section itself carries.

Live lines: tutorRole.points[3] at locale line 151 and faq.items[5].answer at line 182 exist with exactly the two old lines the spec quotes; the dict block lines (en 1, th 277, zh 553) match the copy file.

Repo truth: src/lib/product-pictures.ts, src/components/products/product-picture.tsx (props {picture, alt}), src/components/marketing/section-header.tsx (eyebrow/title/description), src/app/[locale]/globals.css, src/app/[locale]/(marketing)/products/tutor-advantage/page.tsx and page.test.tsx, getScopedI18n, TutorClassStepper all exist. The page renders tutorRole (id become-a-tutor), commitments, faq in the order section 2 assumes. Package name www-reading-advantage matches the --filter values; scripts test=vitest run, build, lint, check-types exist; turbo.json has check-types. scripts/ci/shadcn-ratchet-baseline.json holds lintWarnings 241 and copies 36; scripts/ci/affected-apps.mjs accepts --base/--head; heavy-run.sh exists. The manifest shape {src,width,height,portrait} matches 6.2.

Screens: the set holds 41 student-mobile and 31 tutor-desktop files; the three mapped sources exist at the stated sizes (070 and 002 at 520x1125, 062 at 1440x900); none is on the README do-not-use list (011, 024, 043, 050, 054, student 025); the blur list (all used tutor-desktop, student 070/071) and the plan's four 062 blur locations (header, subtitle, lesson dropdown, progress card) match the README and the screen content.

Screen captions: slot 1 (070) shows the next class, the lesson, and a chat button, no Reedy card — the mismatch is tracked as open question 3 and plan 'Answers owed to PR' 3. Slot 3 (062) fits its caption. Slot 2 (002) fits its caption ('One lesson, 18 phases', the screen shows ขั้นที่ 8/18) but its alt names the tutor app — untracked, finding F2.

Zero decision: leg add/remove (5.2 rule 6, D-4, D-6), first paint (D-6), preset resets the price (D-5), edit clears the preset (D-7), zh block (D-10), input clamping (5.2 rule 1), tax on zero payout (5.2 rule 4), display formats (D-3), explain variant (5.2 rule 5), rate curve (D-11), bar-width mechanism (D-9), component boundary (D-12) are all answered. The one open choice is the F1 test file location.

Testability: AC-1..AC-4 → tutor-commission.test.ts (tasks 1.1/1.2); AC-5, AC-7, AC-8 → www-tutor-calculator.locale.test.ts (1.3/1.4); AC-6 → the same locale test (2.3); AC-9 → tutor-commission-calculator.test.tsx (1.5/1.6); AC-10 → page.test.tsx (1.7/2.2); AC-11/AC-12 → gate commands and git diff; AC-13 → page test plus the unnamed manifest test (F1); AC-14 and AC-15 are written as reviews with named owners (D-14, task 2.5 [b] PM), not as tests; AC-16 → the selector command.
